notes.title: Paratroopers
notes.notes:
BeachHead Forces, Prepare for Battle!

The enemy is evolving—stronger, deadlier, and deploying new tactics. But we won’t back down! Together, we will crush them as we always have.

Look up! A new threat descends from the skies—enemy paratroopers are dropping in, striking from above at any moment, day or night. While you’re holding the front line, they’ll be landing behind you, threatening your survival. Stay sharp, adapt your tactics, and refine your skills to stay ahead.

Are you ready for the challenge? Earn more, survive longer, and prove your dominance on the battlefield!

Changelog:
✅ New Paratrooper Enemy – They land anywhere, anytime. Stay alert!
✅ 3 New Battles – More intense action awaits.
✅ VSync Option – Improve performance and stability.
✅ Battle Rewards Balance – Adjusted for a fairer, more rewarding experience.

Join the fight now and show the enemy who’s in control! 🚀
